user.title: Aquarium Lighting
user.description: Create a Toggle helper for this aquarium's auto mode first (Settings > Devices & services > Helpers > Create helper > Toggle), then select it here. Add another entry later for a second aquarium, each with its own helper.

data_description.auto_entity: ON = this integration controls the lights. OFF = you do.
data_description.transition_seconds: Length of the fade sent with each once-a-minute update. 60 gives a continuous ramp.
data_description.resume_transition_seconds: Fade length used when auto mode is switched on, after a restart, or after a schedule edit.

error.invalid_name: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores only (max 32 characters).

abort.already_configured: That auto-mode helper is already used by another aquarium.

init.title: Aquarium Lighting options
init.description: Step 1 of 2. The next step sets up the moonlight.

moonlight.title: Moonlight
moonlight.description: A light that follows the moon phase. Each night it fades up and back down in a parabola between the start and end time. The peak is the new-moon brightness at new moon, rising in four equal steps to the full-moon brightness at full moon. Needs a sensor that reports the moon phase (the Moon integration's sensor.moon_phase by default). Only runs while auto mode is on.

data_description.start: The window may cross midnight, e.g. 21:00 to 01:00.

error.light_required: Choose the light to use as moonlight, or turn moonlight off.
error.min_above_max: New moon brightness cannot be higher than full moon brightness.
error.same_times: Start and end time must differ.
error.invalid_moonlight: These moonlight settings are not valid.
